question: Does one fixed parameter-free cross-hand map simultaneously satisfy the radius-four joint annihilation rows and the radius-five degree-three-shift extension rows?
candidate_scope: The exact intersection of the five parameter-free maps frozen for the radius-five acquisition with the previously declared radius-four maps; no post-reveal map is added.

augmented_null.matrix: stack conjugate(H_plus_old+extension) above the candidate-transformed H_minus_old+extension
augmented_null.residual: maximum-volume fixed-pivot Schur complement with 35 complex / 70 real locally complete coordinates
augmented_null.spatial_action: The candidate D4 map acts on both coefficient monomials and left shifts.

covariance.old_influence: For each old delete-one replicate, recompute all old Hankel entries and every degree-3/4 entry inside the extension rows while holding the fresh degree-five stream fixed.
covariance.fresh_influence: For each fresh delete-one replicate, recompute the degree-five extension entries while holding the old stream fixed.
covariance.combine: Add the two separately estimated 70x70 jackknife covariance matrices; never align or pool their batch indices.
covariance.cross_candidate: Save the sum of separately computed old and fresh cross-candidate covariance matrices for audit only; form no combined candidate vote.
covariance.resolved_modes: correlation eigenvalues greater than 1e-10 times the largest
covariance.finite_batch_calibration: Use the conservative existing-project Hotelling convention with effective batch count min(400,400)=400.

decision_rule: Report one augmented survival decision per frozen candidate. Do not separately recount the published radius-four annihilation or radius-five direction gates, do not multiply p-values, and do not select the largest p-value. The Alexander family survives iff at least one of R0..R3 survives the augmented gate.
claim_boundary: This is a Level-S truncated rank-five map test through total degree five, not exact rank five, flatness, a physical state dimension, an ordered-word test, or a microscopic graph isomorphism.
The later radius-six rank-five rejection and rank-eight R2 bridge rejection remain separate higher-order results and are not rescored here.
No new simulation is authorized or needed.
